name: City Council Meeting - Oct 22, 2024
agenda_text:
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  OCTOBER 22, 2024
  REGULAR MEETING
  5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
  6:30 P.M. - REGULAR BUSINESS BEGINS
  IN COUNCIL CHAMBER AT 3031 TORRANCE BL.

  CITY COUNCIL MAY TAKE ACTION ON ANY ITEM LISTED ON THE AGENDA

Revised City Council Agenda 10-22-24

*Denotes the item was added or modified after posting of the agenda.

OPENING CEREMONIES

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  ROLL CALL
  : Councilmembers Gerson, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, and Mayor Chen

13.  CLOSED SESSION

*The following item was modified on October 17, 2024.

  13A. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION (California Government Code
  §54957(b)(1)): Title: City Manager

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

RECONVENE

2.  FLAG SALUTE: Councilmember Lewis NON-SECTARIAN INVOCATION:
  Councilmember Mattucci

3.  REPORT OF THE CITY CLERK ON THE POSTING OF THE AGENDA The agenda was
  posted on the Public Notice Board at 3031 Torrance Bl. and on the City’s Website on
  Monday, October 14, 2024 /s/ Rebecca Poirier
  3 - REVISED AFFIDAVIT
  3 - AFFIDAVIT

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READING OF RESOLUTIONS AND ORDINANCES AFTER
NUMBER & TITLE – See Council Rules of Order Section 2.11 (Resolution 2006-65)

4.  ANNOUNCEMENT OF WITHDRAWN, DEFERRED, AND/OR SUPPLEMENTAL ITEMS

5.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

6.  COMMUNITY MATTERS – None Scheduled.
  6A-STAFF REPORT

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items under the Consent Calendar or items that
  are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on
  items raised during public comment, but may respond briefly to statements made or
  questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals
  are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no
  longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If
  presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk
  before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
  PUBLIC COMMENT
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT RECIEVED AFTER 5:30 P.M. ON 10/21/24 AND BEFORE 10:17
  P.M. ON 10/22/24

8.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one
  vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by
  a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..

  8A. City Clerk – Approve City Council Minutes. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Clerk that City Council approve the City Council minutes of
  September 17, 2024 and September 24, 2024.

  8B. City Treasurer – Accept and File Investment Report for the Month of August 2024.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Treasurer that City Council accept and file the Investment
   Report for the month of August 2024.
  8B- STAFF REPORT

  8C. Civil Service Commission and Human Resources – Approve Reclassification of
  1.0 Full-Time Employee (FTE) Administrative Assistant. Expenditure: $14,600
  Annually (General Fund).
  Recommendation of the Civil Service Commission and the Human Resources Director that
  City Council approve the reclassification of 1.0 full-time employee (FTE) Administrative
  Assistant position to the classification of 1.0 FTE Senior Administrative Assistant position in
  the amount of $14,600 per year.
  8C - STAFF REPORT

9.  HEARINGS

*The following item was modified on October 17, 2024.

  9A. Planning Commission and Community Development - Conduct Public Hearing to
  Consider Denial of a Variance to Exempt a Proposed New Two-Story, Single-
  Family Residence from Enforcement of Article 41, Chapter 1, Division 9, of the
  Torrance Municipal Code, Hillside and Local Coastal Overlay Zone, on Property
  Located within the Hillside Overlay in the R-1 Zone at 417 Via Anita (APN 7512-
  027-018). The Project is Statutorily Exempt from CEQA per Guidelines Section
  15270. VAR22-00001: RUKHSANA MIR. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Planning Commission and the Community Development Director
  that City Council:
  1) Conduct Public Hearing; and
  2) Adopt a RESOLUTION denying a Variance to exempt a proposed new two-story,
  single-family residence from enforcement of Article 41, Chapter 1, Division 9, of the
  Torrance Municipal Code, Hillside and Local Coastal Overlay Zone, on property located
  within the Hillside Overlay in the R-1 Zone at 417 Via Anita; and
  3) Determine a Statutory Exemption for the Variance request in accordance with
  Guidelines for Implementation of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA);
  Article 18, Section 15270 (Projects Which Are Disapproved).
  9A - REVISED STAFF REPORT PART 1
  9A - REVISED STAFF REPORT PART 2
  9A-SUPPLEMENTAL

10.  ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS

  10D. Transit and Public Works - Discuss and Provide Direction on City of Inglewood’s
  Transit Connector Proposal to South Bay Cities Council of Governments.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Transit Director and Public Works Director that City Council discuss
  and provide direction on the City of Inglewood's Transit Connector Proposal to the South
  Bay Cities Council of Governments for Measure M funds.
  10D - REVISED STAFF REPORT
  10D- SUPPLEMENTAL #1
  10D- SUPPLEMENTAL #2

  10A. Finance, Community Development, Communications and Information
  Technology, and Police – Approve Fiscal Year 2024-25 Proposed Program
  Modifications. Expenditure: $189,697 (General Fund and General Fund-Measure
  SST Fund).
  Recommendation of the Finance Director, Community Development Director,
  Communications and Information Technology Director, and Chief of Police that City Council:
  1) Approve the proposed program modification in the Community Development
  Department’s fiscal year 2024-25 General Fund operating budget in the amount of
  ($13,712) per year; and
  2) Approve the proposed program modification in the Police Department’s fiscal year
  2024-25 General Fund-Measure SST Fund operating budget in the amount of
  $203,409 per year.
  10A-STAFF REPORT
   10B. Police – Renew Ordinance 3902 Approving Military Equipment Use Policy.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Chief of Police that City Council:
  1) Determine based on the Military Equipment 2023-24 Annual Report whether each type
  of equipment has complied with the standards for approval set forth in Government
  Code section 7071 (d); and
  2) Renew Ordinance 3902 approving the Police Department’s military equipment use
  policy.
  10B - STAFF REPORT
  10B- SUPPLEMENTAL

  10C. City Council State Legislative Advocacy Committee – Discuss and Consider
  Position on November 5, 2024 General Election Ballot Measures and Accept and
  File Meeting Minutes. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Council State Legislative Advocacy Committee that City
  Council:
  1) Discuss and consider a position on November 5, 2024 General Election Ballot
  Measures; and
  2) Accept and file the City Council State Legislative Advocacy Committee meeting
  minutes from October 9, 2024.
  10C- STAFF REPORT
  10C- STAFF PRESENTATION

*The following item was modified on October 17, 2024.

11.  AGENCY AGENDAS ? None Scheduled.

12.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) Council Order –
  Mattucci, Sheikh, Gerson, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis and Mayor Chen This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M.
  Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may
  respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer
  the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1
  or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts
  when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council,
  please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be
  distributed while you speak.

RECESS TO CLOSE SESSION

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

14.  ADJOURNMENT

  14A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, October 29, 2024, at 5:00 p.m.
  for closed session, with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the LeRoy
  J. Jackson Council Chamber.
  14A - STAFF REPORT
